evidence_notes: WHO2026-01 DB10.00 generalized peritonitis, DB10.01 localized peritonitis/contained abscess, DB10.02 without peritonitis are explicitly separated. Chronic appendicitis not counted. SAGES2024 surgical preference is conditional and excludes pregnancy from its evidence review; WSES2025edition original abstract published2026 supports selected uncomplicated antibiotic care. Some studies and Mayo/Cleveland educational references overlapNIH/ACS; no independent-trial claim. HistoricalNIDDK fixed drainage schedules/open-surgery preference not universalized. NIH diet evidence and newerCleveland general fibre language differ; only lack of reliable guaranteed dietary prevention is claimed. ACS absolute no-recurrence statement superseded by currentNHS stump-appendicitis exception. No treatment doses, cancer percentages or home waiting cutoff.
